senses.definition: (Baer קֶצֶה) n.[m.] end (on—ֵBaNB § 12 a, and [on ה] Köii. 1, 65);—only אֵין ק׳, usually + ל, no end to (of), Is 2:7(×2) Na 2:10; 3:3; abs. אֵין קֵ֑צֶה v 9.
